title: Full Stack Product Engineer (Design & Geospatial)
description:
City Detect | Full Stack Product Engineer (Design & Geospatial) | Tuscaloosa, AL | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | $110k-$159k + equity City Detect uses AI and computer vision to map the physical world for cities. Sensors capture street-level conditions so local governments can find and respond to issues like blight and track how neighborhoods change over time. Founded in 2021, Series A, working with municipalities across Texas, California, Florida, and beyond. We're looking for a frontend-leaning full stack engineer with a strong eye for design to own the map-heavy parts of our product. That means interactive maps, spatial data explorers and dashboards that city staff use to make decisions. Stack: React/TypeScript, Python/FastAPI on AWS Lambda, Aurora PostgreSQL + PostGIS. Experience with Mapbox, deck.gl, Leaflet, D3, vector tiles/H3, or nation-scale OSM data is a big plus. Mid to senior level. Small team, close work with the founders, real ownership. Process: phone screen, portfolio/design review, 1-2 technical conversations, references, then a chat with our CEO. No LeetCode. Perks: unlimited PTO, health/dental/vision, $100/mo wellness stipend, team retreats twice a year. Apply: https://jobs.gem.com/citydetect/am9icG9zdDr5AWjF1AZ1UgSdc0I0...

title: Account Executive (m/w/d) im Außendienst - Nürnberg
description:
Du fühlst dich im Vertrieb zu Hause und möchtest ein eigenes Gebiet im Außendienst aufbauen und verantworten? Bei uns heißt das: Verantwortung übernehmen, kurze Sales-Zyklen betreuen, ungedeckelte Provision verdienen und echte Entwicklungschancen nutzen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey's Finance Engineering team is the investment-side counterpart to our Legal Engineering team: former investment professionals who bring real deal experience to Harvey's prospects and customers. Forward Deployed Finance Engineers lead discovery, demos, pilots, trainings, onboarding, and custom builds alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real investment work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom-built workflow.

Finance Engineers work on Harvey Deals, a new product built off of Harvey's acquisition of Benchmark. Harvey Deals is where investment teams run their deals - screening, underwriting, diligence, and committee materials - built in the firm's own templates and formats, with every figure traceable back to the document it came from. Harvey works with 150+ asset management firms and analyzes 178M+ documents each month; the Finance Engineering team is how that capability meets the way deal teams actually work.

Finance Engineers understand how investors think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live deal pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. It's a team built to make Harvey the platform investment teams can trust with their most important work.

This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to private credit. You will build the credit playbook - demo library, workflow templates, use cases - while running live pilots, and lead the credit practice as the team grows.

You may be asked to travel around 2-3+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1-3 days at a time.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Forward Deployed Finance Engineers on the private credit team are former credit investors who left the desk to help build the future of how credit gets underwritten. Working closely with Account Executives, they engage with direct lenders, opportunistic and specialty finance managers, BDC managers, and insurer credit arms throughout the pre-sales process and stay with them well past it - leading pilots on live opportunities, guiding lenders through what's possible with AI, and sitting down with credit teams to build screening, underwriting, and credit committee workflows in the firm's own templates and formats.

The work is the work they did on the desk: lender presentation and CIM review; QoE read-throughs and data pack analysis; cash flow and leverage modeling; sizing and structuring; covenant and credit agreement review; credit memo drafting; and comps. You stay curious and sceptical . You ask why the AI gave an answer, and you check it before you trust it.

title: Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

• Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler

• Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime

• Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64

• Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions

• Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

• 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering

• Strong C++ design and coding skills

• Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations

• Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

Very Nice to Have

• Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8

• Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler

• Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

• Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals

• MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

For more than 25 years we’ve solved complex problems through strategy, design and development on open-source platforms, primarily Drupal and WordPress, including headless and composable architectures.

We’re looking for a Director of Business Development to own new business growth. You’ll sell website redesigns, platform migrations, discovery and digital strategy, and multi-year support to marketing, digital and IT leaders, with typical engagements of $150,000 to $500,000.
The role has two key responsibilities. Second, you’ll own our sales process for every opportunity that comes to us through referrals, partners, RFPs, our website and marketing. Key deliverables

•
Build your book of business - Build and work a named target-account list across our core sectors using research-driven, personalized outreach by email, LinkedIn, phone and events. Develop referral and partner channels with platform partners, design firms, systems integrators and past clients.

•

• Working with our CEO and Marketing Director, build a target-account plan of 150 organizations.

In your first year

Key Requirements

• 7+ years in B2B sales, including 3+ years in new business roles at a digital agency, consultancy or technology services firm.

This is not a traditional panel-based practice.

This is a great fit if you enjoy finding smarter, lower-cost design solutions and seeing your work built in the field.
As a Leidos employee, you can look forward to a dynamic & collaborative culture, as well as managers who will encourage career development and growth opportunities , including:

• Professional Engineer (PE) Licensure

• Formal Mentorship programs

• Developmental Leadership training

In this role, you can expect to:

• Assist senior engineers with engineering studies, site evaluations, constructability reviews, and technical design assessments.

• Prepare project deliverables including engineered drawings, design calculations, technical reports, material take-offs, project correspondence, and construction support documentation.

• Evaluate the impacts of design changes across multiple disciplines and recommend technically sound and cost-effective solutions.

• Perform Quality Control reviews of physical design deliverables for smaller projects.

• Support proposal development efforts by providing drawing counts, scope input, manhour estimates, and technical support for substation physical engineering activities.

• Assist in the development and continuous improvement of engineering processes, design standards, and best practices to enhance project execution efficiency.

• Maintain accurate project records, calculations, and design files while ensuring a high level of organization and attention to detail.

• Continue to expand technical knowledge of substation physical design, equipment applications, industry standards, and utility practices.

• Develop and deliver technical presentations and knowledge-sharing sessions to support team development and training initiatives.

• Provide engineering support during procurement, construction, commissioning, and field

title: Senior Digital Analytics Consultant

Flying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East. Our mission is to help our clients Unleash Digital Potential™ .
We work at scales where real impact happens: enterprise platforms, government services, and corporate ecosystems used by millions of people. That’s why we’re building the discipline of Strategic Design - and we want you to be part of it.
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Digital Analytics Consultant to partner with Flying Bisons on client projects. You will work with organisations to design and optimise analytics ecosystems, define KPIs, audit tracking implementations, analyse user behaviour, and turn data into actionable recommendations that improve business performance, digital products, and user experience. Beyond reporting, you will help clients understand what the data means, identify opportunities, and make informed, data-driven decisions.

• Analyse data from websites, apps, digital products, and campaigns.

• Work with clients and internal teams to define business goals, KPIs, and analytics needs.

• Advanced knowledge of GA4, including configuration, events, conversions, audiences, reporting, and data interpretation.

• Strong experience with Google Tag Manager, including tags, triggers, variables, data layer, and event tracking.

• Practical knowledge of BigQuery and SQL.

• Experience in an agency, consulting, or project-based environment.

• Experience in designing measurement plans and defining KPIs.

• Ability to turn data into clear business, product, and UX recommendations.

• Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders.

• Ability to lead meetings, workshops, or analytics consultations.

You will lead and develop WFM professionals while partnering with Operations, Analytics, Product, and Technology. title: Strategy Analytics Manager
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

Lendable is revolutionising the credit card industry by making financial tools accessible, intuitive, and empowering. Zable is a Mobile-App first credit card that empowers customers to build their credit score while meeting their spending and borrowing needs sustainably.

We’re looking for an analytical, commercially-minded Strategy Analytics Manager to help us grow and scale the product exponentially. This is a dynamic role where you’ll tackle high impact business problems across a number of disciplines including pricing, financial forecasting, growth, credit risk, new product development and product analytics.

You’ll work cross-functionally to deliver insight-driven strategies that optimise performance, drive responsible growth, and put the customer at the heart of decision-making.

You’ll operate in a fast-paced environment where ideas matter more than hierarchy, and execution beats bureaucracy. Your work will directly influence who we serve, how we grow, and how we deliver sustainable value.

 
 

Your impact

- Drive promotions & pricing strategy: Develop and optimise promotional and pricing strategies through data-driven analysis and experimentation, balancing customer engagement, growth, price elasticity and profitability while continuously refining approaches based on product performance and scenario modelling. Build deep insight into marketing campaign and conversion funnel performance, identifying opportunities to improve cost and conversion efficiency. Stay abreast of industry trends and competitor activity to ensure our products remain fit for purpose.

- Financial forecasting & portfolio analytics: Collaborate closely with the Credit Risk Analytics, Growth and Data Science teams to understand how our products and portfolio are performing at a granular sub-segment level. Define key KPIs and develop detailed monitoring to track performance against these goals, and deliver actionable recommendations to improve outcomes. Use strategic analysis to shape and influence broader business strategy.

- Evaluate expansion opportunities: Navigate through ambiguity to assess the feasibility of new product, channel and segment expansion opportunities. Create robust commercial assessment frameworks, build tooling where necessary (e.g. RoI or NPV models) and extract data to support these assessments and deliver clear, insight-driven recommendations.

- Influence & execution: Collaborate with stakeholders across Credit Risk, Data Science, Product and Growth to bring your strategies to life. Present insights and recommendati

title: Learning Experience (LX) Platform Manager
locationText: Aurora, Colorado, United States; Aurora +8 more
description:
ABOUT HELLOFRESH GROUP

At HelloFresh, we want to change the way people eat forever by offering our customers high-quality food and recipes for different meal occasions. Over the past decade, we've grown from a single meal kit brand into a global food solutions group - the world's leading meal kit company, active in 18+ countries across 3 continents.

The HelloFresh Group includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Factor (ready-to-eat), Chefs Plate, and Youfoodz. Each brand serves a distinct audience but shares our commitment to making good food accessible and sustainable. Our Distribution Centers are the operational heartbeat of everything we deliver - and equipping the people who work in them with the right training, at the right time, in the right format, is fundamental to how we operate.

ABOUT THE ROLE: WHAT'S IN THE BOX

The Learning Platform Manager is the connective tissue between the content our Training Content team creates and the learners who need it. This is a hands-on, operationally grounded role responsible for the health, configuration, and strategic growth of our 360Learning platform across a multi-brand, multi-site network - while also serving as the primary coordination point for training program rollout, stakeholder alignment, and platform-enabled learning design.

You will own the platform end-to-end: user management, course architecture, learning path design, integrations, reporting, and the continuous improvement of how learning is experienced by our Tier 1 DC associates and operational leaders. You will partner daily with the Training Content Manager to translate finished content into published learning experiences, and with Operations, HR, Safety, and OpEX to ensure training is reaching the right people at the right time.

This role is also a direct manager - you will lead and develop one Senior Learning Experience Designer, who shares responsibility for platform administration and content quality support. Together, you are the function that makes the entire training ecosystem visible, measurable, and continuously improving.

 

Scope Area

Details

Platform

360Learning (primary LMS) - full administrative ownership; Workday integration (in progress) for automated enrollment and user management

Brands & Sites

All 4 brands (HelloFresh, EveryPlate, Green Chef, Factor) across all current and future US DC sites; EU and ANZ expansion planned

Learner Audience

Tier 1 DC associates, line leads, supervisors, operational management, and corporate staff

Content Interface

Receives content from Training Content Specialists and VDM team; publishes, structures, and optimizes for learner delivery within 360Learning

Reporting

Completion tracking, compliance records, engagement analytics, and learning program effectiveness reporting to operations and leadership

Integrations

Workday HRIS (in implementation); future integrations as platform scales globally

Geographic Scope

US operations at launch; EU and ANZ expansion as the global program matures

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO: THE RECIPE

Platform Ownership & Administration

• Own the 360Learning platform as its primary administrator: user accounts, group hierarchies, role permissions, course catalog organization, and system configuration across all brands and sites

• Manage and maintain the Workday-360Learning integration, ensuring automated enrollment, role-based course assignment, and learner data accuracy as employees onboard, transfer, or change roles across the network

• Define and govern the platform architecture: group structures, learning path frameworks, program-level organization, and the naming and tagging conventions that keep a multi-brand, multi-site catalog navigable at scale

• Monitor platform health: identify enrollment gaps, stalled learner progress, broken content links, and course configuration issues before they become operational problems

• Manage platform vendor relationship with 360Learning - serve as the primary contact

title: Regional Accountant Sr/Ssr.
description:
About Coderio
 
Coderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. With a strong technical foundation and a product-oriented mindset, our teams lead complex software projects from architecture through execution.
We value autonomy, clear communication, and technical excellence. We work closely with international teams and partners, building technology that creates real impact.
 
🌍 More information:http://coderio.com
 
In this role, you will join the Operational Accounting team supporting a high-growth business unit in a global payments technology company. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy of financial information, analyzing business processes to drive automation, and ensuring compliance with corporate requirements and internal controls.
 
What you can expect from this role (Responsibilities)
 
Perform balance sheet and P&L reconciliations, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely resolution of differences.
Conduct account analysis, explaining variances and trends with a driver-based, data-backed approach.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages for the group.
Execute and document SOX controls and other internal controls, maintaining clear audit trails.
Analyze business processes and propose improvement opportunities, focusing on standardization and automation.
Manage accounts payable, fixed assets, bank reconciliations, and expenses/budget tracking.
Support external and internal audits by preparing workpapers and supporting documentation.
Post accounting journal entries supported by complete analysis and consistent application of policies.
 
Requirements
 
Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field.3+ years of experience in Accounting teams, ideally in multinational or high-growth environments.
Solid knowledge of accounting postings/imputations, debits/credits, and key close processes.
Advanced Excel proficiency (pivot tables, lookups, basic modeling).
Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) for daily international collaboration.
General understanding of IFRS and core financial statements.
Ability to work in a fast-changing environment and deliver on tight month-end timelines.
 
Nice to have
 
Experience using ERPs such as SAP (Fiori), Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics.
Experience with process automation or data analysis tools (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Alteryx, RPA).
Exposure to emerging markets, payments, fintech, or high-transaction-volume businesses.
Experience with group-level/corporate reporting packages and consolidations.
 
Benefits
 
100% remote
Strategic, high-visibility role within a modern engineering culture
Collaborative international team and strong technical leadership
Career plan with growth and leadership opportunities within Coderio
 
Why join Coderio?
 
At Coderio, we value talent regardless of location. We are a remote-first company, passionate about technology, collaborative work, and fair compensation. We offer an inclusive, challenging environment with real opportunities for growth.
If you are motivated by building impactful solutions, we are waiting for you. Apply now.

title: Voice Recorder (Hindi + English)
description:
Role Title: Voice Recorder (Hindi + English)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Hindi bilingual experts to contribute to a customer's audio project focused on advancing machine learning. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Record yourself reading sentences in Hindi, either from a stationary car or a quiet office environment.

• Create specific background noises (such as seatbelt clicks, door openings, or car indicator signals) while ensuring all audio is captured with the vehicle stationary and in a safe manner.

• Follow detailed linguistic and technical guidelines to ensure consistency and reliability of language data.

• Submit high-quality audio recordings and accompanying written feedback as required by the project.

• Collaborate remotely with project coordinators on clarifications, updates, or feedback related to deliverables.

• Ensure all recordings and data submissions comply with confidentiality and ethical use guidelines.

Preferred Qualifications

• Native-level proficiency in Hindi, with clear enunciation and natural fluency.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Hindi and at least B2-level English.

• Ability to follow precise instructions and meet project specifications for audio quality and content.

• Comfort working independently in a remote setting and managing your own workflow for assigned tasks.

• Attention to detail, especially regarding pronunciation, background noise, and data accuracy.
